description: The market section (default null = no local auction house — every market.* verb refuses by name) — see WorldMarketSection. Optional, for the same reason Rules is. Trailing by design, after Admission, for the identical reason every optional section here is.

formats.description: Which WorldMarketFormat values a listing may declare, or null to permit both.

items.description: The trade shapes a WorldMarketListing may declare — authored rule shapes over the total-ordered bid journal, never a free-form auction engine.

feeBasisPoints.description: The house fee, in basis points of a settled sale's price (0..MaxFeeBasisPoints), credited to FeeReserve at settlement — never destroyed, so escrow conservation holds across the fee too.

minDurationSeconds.description: The least authored listing duration this market admits.

maxDurationSeconds.description: The greatest authored listing duration this market admits.

admissionTiers.description: The declared per-tier admission rules (see WorldMarketAdmissionTier) — validated and round-tripped, locally inert.

items.description: One per-tier admission rule a WorldMarketSection may declare. Validated and round-tripped today; not yet consulted by any listing/bid/buyout compose arm — LOCAL enforcement is admit-everyone (the trivial self-mint posture the fact vocabulary's Provenance also takes), and a federated authority is expected to consult this row before it enforces attestation.

name.description: The tier's stable name, unique within the section.

requireAttestation.description: Whether a participant must carry a ring attestation to trade under this tier — authored now, inert until federation reads it.

listings.description: The live listing ledger — engine- and player-mutated, never re-seeded from the document on boot the way Formats/AdmissionTiers are (matches groups' authored-vs-runtime split for its own WorldOwnership rows).

items.description: One listing on the market — an item escrowed out of its seller's spendable set the moment this row is created, resolved exactly once by a buyout, a cancel, or the deadline sweep. ItemRow/ CurrencyRow each name a keyed state row (see WorldStateCell's remarks) whose cells are addressed by a holder's 0-based Index — the item/currency fact vocabulary this listing moves quantity through, never a second inventory system.

id.description: The listing's engine-minted, monotonically increasing id (see NextListingId).

seller.description: The seller — always a Seat or Peer principal (a real player, never the console/world/an addon/a group).

itemRow.description: The keyed state row carrying the traded item's per-holder quantity.

quantity.description: How much of ItemRow this listing escrows — decremented from the seller's own cell at creation, credited to the winner's cell at settlement, or returned to the seller's cell on cancel/expiry.

currencyRow.description: The keyed state row carrying the price currency's per-holder balance.

format.description: Which trade shape this listing runs.

startPrice.description: The minimum opening bid (English); unused by, and must be zero for, Buyout.

deadlineTick.description: The engine tick at or after which the deadline sweep (Server.WorldServer's per-tick market pass, the same shape as its own ReclaimExpiredEscrows) settles or expires this listing — derived once, at creation, from the authored duration seconds through DurationTicks; never re-derived.

buyoutPrice.description: The instant-win price, or null for an English listing carrying none. Required for Buyout.

currentBid.description: The highest accepted bid so far (English only); zero while unbid.

currentBidder.description: Who placed CurrentBid, or null while unbid.

resolvedTick.description: The tick Status left Active at, or null while still active — the retention sweep's own age basis (Server.WorldServer's PruneMarketListings compose arm), never re-derived from DeadlineTick (a cancel or buyout resolves long before its deadline, so the deadline cannot stand in for "when this row actually became terminal").

nextListingId.description: The next Id a WorldMutation.CreateMarketListing mints — engine bookkeeping, monotonically increasing, never reused.

feeReserve.description: The house's accumulated fee take — engine bookkeeping; the fee sink escrow conservation balances against.

retentionSeconds.description: How long a terminal row (Settled/ Cancelled/Expired) stands, past its own ResolvedTick, before the engine's own per-tick retention sweep (Server.WorldServer's PruneMarketListings compose arm) archives it — the bound half of MaxListings: an active row is never eligible however old, so a market that never resolves anything still fills at exactly MaxListings live listings. Converted to ticks the same way a listing's own MinDurationSeconds/MaxDurationSeconds become its DeadlineTick (DurationTicks).
